import fitz
from docx import Document

doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")

pdf = fitz.open()

lines = []
for para in doc.paragraphs:
    text = para.text
    if text.strip():
        lines.append(text)

fontsize = 11
margin = 72
page_width = 595
page_height = 842
usable_width = page_width - 2 * margin
usable_height = page_height - 2 * margin

page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
y = margin

for line in lines:
    # Estimate if we need a new page
    if y + fontsize + 4 > page_height - margin:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=page_width, height=page_height)
        y = margin

    # Insert text
    text_point = fitz.Point(margin, y + fontsize)
    # Use insert_text for simple text placement
    rc = page.insert_text(text_point, line, fontsize=fontsize, fontname="helv")
    y += fontsize + 4

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully")
